race.description: 92.5 Triple M Gold Brekkie Leisel Liam Spida Hcp (Bm60)
race.comment: FIORSUM FRED (3) is ticking along nicely and is desperate to break through after two close finishes. At his top now, just needs to carry the weight. LARUSSO (5) hasn't won for a long time but is knocking on the door and doesn't have to lift the bar too far to land a winning blow. Gets a key switch in Maloney, which could prove decisive. SIR GOLDALOT (4) is holding his form well, with a Gold Coast Poly second following a Toowoomba win. Expect KWT to hunt the front and give supporters another bold look. SNUGG (10) continues to savage the line but keeps leaving herself with too much ground to bridge. Will drift back again from the draw and can cause a late scare.
